newsitem.title: UK: Rolling Stones Ronnie Wood shows new talent.
newsitem.headline: Rolling Stones Ronnie Wood shows new talent.

text.p: Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood is to run a major retrospective exhibition of his prints in London and Dublin.
Subjects range from Chuck Berry to Mick Jagger for the musician who is now as happy sketching with a pencil as he is playing the guitar.

The limited edition prints are to be put on display in the British and Irish capitals next month, organisers of the exhibition said on Wednesday. Lithographs of the Rolling Stones are on offer at 3,000 pounds ($5,000) apiece.
